Who stole the Halloween candy?

A real office mystery. You're the detective.

What happened

On Friday at 2 p.m., HR left a huge bowl of chocolate bars in the office kitchen. The candy was for the employees' kids on Halloween.

At 5:30 p.m., all the chocolate was gone. The bowl was full of candy corn instead, and there was glitter on the floor.
